in_hebrew.name: Nonah
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Nonah הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'νοεω' (noeo), meaning 'to think, to contemplate'. In Greek mythology, Noe was the name of the goddess of wisdom and the personification of the mind. Nonah is a feminine variant of the name, which can be interpreted as 'grace' or 'favor'.
